description: This file defines the internal sealed partial class 'SocketConnection' which manages socket-based network connections, including data transmission, reception, error handling, and connection lifecycle management within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: Manages a network socket connection, handling data transfer, connection lifecycle, and error management within the Orleans networking infrastructure.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the asynchronous processing of the socket connection by starting the receive and send loops.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that runs the receive and send processing tasks and handles cleanup after completion.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the connection in response to an abort reason.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the connection, completing the transport pipes and awaiting ongoing processing tasks.

methods.name: DoReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming data reception, processing socket errors, and completing the input pipe.

methods.name: ProcessReceives
methods.description: Main loop for receiving data from the socket and writing it into the input pipe.

methods.name: DoSend
methods.description: Handles outgoing data transmission, managing socket errors, and shutting down the connection.

methods.name: ProcessSends
methods.description: Main loop for reading data from the output pipe and sending it over the socket.

methods.name: FireConnectionClosed
methods.description: Triggers the connection closed event, ensuring it is only scheduled once.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs a thread-safe shutdown of the socket, disposing resources and setting shutdown reasons.

methods.name: CancelConnectionClosedToken
methods.description: Cancels the connection closed token source to signal connection closure.

methods.name: IsConnectionResetError
methods.description: Determines if a socket error code indicates a connection reset.

methods.name: IsConnectionAbortError
methods.description: Determines if a socket error code indicates a connection abort.
